headline: Net income surges as revenue cools from last quarter
summary_short: GameStop reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $835.3M, down 24.4% q/q but up 14.0% y/y, while net income jumped to $389.6M, up 204.6% q/q and 769.6% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $835.3M fell 24.4% sequentially from $1,104.3M but rose 14.0% year-over-year from $732.4M. Gross profit of $340.3M was down 12.0% q/q and up 34.6% y/y, while operating income of $138.7M fell 4.3% q/q but grew 461.5% y/y. Net income of $389.6M rose 204.6% q/q and 769.6% y/y, far outpacing operating income growth — the gap is not explained by KPI data alone. Diluted EPS of $0.66 rose 200.0% q/q and 633.3% y/y. This is a KPI-only summary; no filing was read, so drivers of the net-income divergence from operating income are not assessed.
